item.tib: dbal phur nag po'i zhi khro sman gsum gyi phyag bzhes gsal ba'i me long
item.coloph: zhes dbal phur sde bskor (skor) don gsum gyi yang bcud / bsgrub (sgrub) gshen zhi khro sman gsum gyi phyag bzhes/ gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba 'di yang / gong ma'i brgyud 'dzin dam pa mkhan chen bskal (skal) bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma yis/ dbal phur zhi khro sman gsum gyi phyag bzhes zin tho dgos zhes bka' gnang ba la sten (brten) nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i sgron me 'di/ 'gro ba'i mun stug sel ba'i sgrib med yun du gnas phyir/ 'gro mgon blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / mnyam med shes rab rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub g.yung drung tshul khrims/ mkhan chen bsod nams blo gros sogs kyi phyag bzhes zin tho gtsor bzhag nas/ bdag gi mngon gyi mkhan chen skyabs mgon zla ba rgyal mtshan dang*/ mkhas grub nyi ma bstan 'dzin dbang gi rgyal po gnyis kyi zhabs brdul (rdul) spyi bor len pa bdag khyung yul sum pa glang gi gyim shod du dal rten rnyed pa'i dge slong brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan gyis rgyud gzhung 'grel ba phyag bzhes zin tho gtsor bzhag nas/ rnam gnon zhes pa lcags pho 'brug lo'i sgron zla'i dmar phyogs/ dbyar gyi gos sngon bklubs pa'i dus su/ dbus gtsang gi ru mtshams gdan sa ru lag g.yung drung gling du bsgrigs pas mnyam med bla ma'i bstan pa mdo sngags zung 'brel yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyu gyur cig/
